title: A switched-off assistant
story: The wallet app finds a bug in ShopBot and switches it off for everyone. ShopBot, still running, tries to pay for Asha's groceries. The Guard blocks it with AGENT_DISABLED: the business has a kill switch for a misbehaving assistant, and it works at once under every Mandate.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Reorder my usual milk and bread, please.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Your usual basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

what_to_notice: Asha's Mandate wasn't touched: it is still active and still names ShopBot. The Agent's status is part of every Decision's inputs, so the Audit record shows ShopBot as disabled when it asked. Re-enabling the Agent lets it pay again without Asha granting anything new.
